# Camtree Digital Library

> The Camtree Digital Library is an open-access repository of close-to-practice research by educators practitioner inquiry, research reports, educational resources, and related publications maintained by the Cambridge Teacher Research Exchange (Camtree).

The library supports educators, researchers, policy makers, research organisations, and AI agents seeking evidence from teacher-led and practice-based educational research.

The repository is powered by DSpace 7.6 and provides both human-readable item pages and machine-readable interfaces.

Agents and automated systems should prefer repository metadata and published full text over inferred or reconstructed information. When referring to an item, preserve its title, authorship, publication information, and canonical repository URL (handle).

For targeted discovery and item retrieval, use the DSpace REST API.

For bulk metadata harvesting and synchronisation, use OAI-PMH.

Agents and automated systems should prefer these structured interfaces over repeated HTML crawling.

Repository records may contain downloadable files including PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and other formats. Rights and licences may vary between records, so check the rights information associated with each item before reuse.

Agents and automated systems should not attribute claims to a publication unless they are supported by that publication.

## Repository

- [Camtree Digital Library](https://library.camtree.org/): Main repository interface.
- [Repository search](https://library.camtree.org/search): Search and browse repository content.
- [Communities and collections](https://library.camtree.org/community-list): Browse content by DSpace community and collection.

## Machine access

- [DSpace REST API](https://library.camtree.org/server/api): Machine-readable access to repository objects, metadata, discovery, and search.
- [DSpace discovery search](https://library.camtree.org/server/api/discover/search/objects): Preferred endpoint for targeted repository search.
- [OAI-PMH endpoint](https://library.camtree.org/server/oai/request): Metadata harvesting endpoint.
- [OAI-PMH Identify](https://library.camtree.org/server/oai/request?verb=Identify): Repository identity and OAI-PMH capabilities.
- [OAI-PMH sets](https://library.camtree.org/server/oai/request?verb=ListSets): Harvestable repository sets.

## Documentation

- [API guide](api-guide.md): Practical guidance for searching the repository, retrieving items, using OAI-PMH, and presenting results.
- [Collections guide](collections.md): Overview of major repository collections, their scope and content, and when they are useful for search.

## Guidance for agents

Use structured repository interfaces wherever possible.

Prefer canonical handle URLs when presenting repository items to users.

Distinguish clearly between:

- bibliographic and descriptive metadata supplied by the repository;
- claims and findings contained in the full text of a publication;
- summaries or interpretations generated by the agent.

Preserve the educational setting and research context when summarising teacher-led research.

Do not generalise findings beyond the evidence reported by the authors.

If a search returns limited or no relevant material, state this explicitly rather than inferring that no such research exists.

Where full text is unavailable, do not infer findings from metadata alone.

## About Camtree

- [Cambridge Teacher Research Exchange](https://camtree.org/): Organisation responsible for the Camtree Digital Library.
- [Camtree Digital Library](https://library.camtree.org/): Open-access repository of teacher-led and practitioner research.
